description: Empirical specific-energy and power lookup vs seawater concentration Csw (freshwater fixed at 0.5 g/L). Osmotic pressure dpi = nu*(C/M)*1000*R*T extracted at efficiency eta_membrane; specific energy SE=eta_m*dpi; net power = SE*Q_permeate*eta_turbine*eta_pressure_exchanger. Tabulated and interpolated.

eta_membrane.note: PRO membrane efficiency (fraction of osmotic pressure extracted)

SE_design_kWh_per_m3.note: Extractable specific energy at design (Csw=35 g/L)

P_net_design_kw.note: Net power at design seawater concentration

specific_energy_kWh_per_m3.note: Extractable specific energy per m3 permeate

source: Yip & Elimelech (2012) Environ. Sci. Technol. 46:5230; Straub et al. (2016) Nature Energy 1:16090; REDstack BV data; reuses EC139 F1a parameters
